crafts.name: DIY bubble wand
instructions: Cut the plastic straws into little pieces (not too thin, 1 cm thick each)
Line them on a strip of double sided tape
Remove the paper of the tape and roll the straw pieces into a spiral
Cut out a 2 cm thick circle of a plastic bottle
Insert the straw spiral into the plastic bottle
Poke a hole in the plastic circle and insert the long toothpick through that hole
Dip into a bubble solution and enjoy!
crafts.sustainability_note: The plastic straws are reused into a fun and easy DIY bubble wand
environmental_benefits: Prevents harmful chemicals from seeping into the environment
